attachments.origin_landmark: median fibrous septum of the tongue
attachments.insertion_landmark: submucous fibrous tissue at the lateral margin of the tongue

functional_compartments.name: Single fiber population
functional_compartments.function_note: Works with the vertical fibres as an antagonistic pair: together they let the tongue change shape at constant volume, which is the muscular-hydrostat mechanism it shares with an elephant's trunk.
functional_compartments.source: Gray's Anatomy for Students, 4th ed. (Drake, Vogl, Mitchell); Moore KL, Dalley AF, Agur AMR, Clinically Oriented Anatomy, 8th ed.; Terminologia Anatomica (FICAT 1998)
